marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind light becoming northwest 15 knots Thursday
afternoon. Scattered showers beginning overnight changing to scattered
flurries Thursday evening. Fog patches forming late overnight and dissipating
near noon Thursday. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Thursday
evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Friday: Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to light in
 the morning.<br/>Saturday: Wind south 15 knots.<br/>Sunday: Wind northeast 15 knots.<br/>
